heading.en: Amendment of regulation I in Schedule to Chapter I 8

text.en: Regulation I of the Old Age and Disability Pensions Regulations, in these Regulations referred to as the principal Regulations, is amended by deleting "and Disability Pensions" and by substituting "Pensions and Disability Allowances" therefor.
Regulation 2 of the principal Regulations is repealed.
Regulation 3 of the principal Regulations is repealed and the following new regulation is substituted therefor"Old age pensions
Regulation 4 of the principal Regulations is repealed and the following new regulation is substituted therefor"Allowances for the blind
Regulation 5 of the principal Regulations is repealed and the following new regulation is substituted therefor''Rehabilitation allowance for persons suffering from Hansen's disease
Regulation 6 of the principal Regulations is repealed.
Regulation 7 of the principal Regulations is repealed and the following new regulation is substituted therefor.. Allowances for mental disorder
Regulation 8 of the principal Regulations is repealed and the following new regulation is substituted therefor"Disability allowance
Regulation I 0 of the principal Regulations is amended by deleting "shall" from the last line and by substituting "may" therefor. Amendment of regulation 12
Regulation 12 of the principal Regulations is amended by inserting "at such frequency as the Controller may determine" immediately after "thereto" in the second line.

Regulation 13 of the principal Regulations is amended(a) in the regulation heading. by deleting "His Majesty in Council" and by substituting "His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan" therefor:

(b) by deleting "His Majesty in Council" and by substituting "His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan" therefor. Substitution of Schedule

The Schedule to the principal Regulations is repealed and the following new Schedule is substituted therefor·'SCHEDULE (regulations 3, 4, 5. 7. 8 and 8A)

PENSIONS AND ALLOWANCES Pension or allowance Rate per momlz I. Old age pension $250

(I) For the purposes of these Regulations. the Controller shall issue guidelines to determine whether the statutory conditions are fulfilled.

(2) The Controller may. from time to time, amend the guidelines as he may think fit. Guidelines to determine persons suffering from blindness etc. SC. (I) For the purposes of regulations 4, 7 and 8, the Director-General of Medical Services shall issue guidelines relating to the criteria on the determination of persons suffering from blindness, mental disorder or disability, respectively.

(2) The Director-General of Medical Services may, from time to time, amend the guidelines as he may think fit.". Amendment of regulation 10
